name: CodeRifts contract gate
description: Ask CodeRifts before an agent writes a contract artifact.

apiKey.description: CodeRifts API key. WITHOUT IT THE GATE CANNOT OBTAIN A DECISION: the keyless path returns risk information only (authorization_effect NONE, may_execute false), so every gated call falls to approval.

timeoutMs.description: Budget for the CodeRifts call. Default 5000. Keep it well under the host's 15000ms before_tool_call budget so a slow answer becomes a named approval request rather than an opaque host denial.

operation.description: context.operation sent with the change set. Default tool_call.
